name: talkbar
description: TalkBar releases, documentation site (docs/) and website (website/)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix docs install && npm --prefix website install
scripts.check: npm --prefix docs run check:content && npm --prefix website test && npm --prefix website run lint && npm --prefix website run check
scripts.deploy:docs: npm run build:docs && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy docs/dist --project-name talkbar-docs --branch main
scripts.deploy:docs:ru: npm run build:docs:ru && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy docs/dist --project-name talkbar-docs-ru --branch main
